headline: Farmland lease bids and tillage specifications for fields 1A and 1C, plus reports on 155 Grieb Rd and 205 Main St.
summary: Farmland lease bid status and tillage recommendations for fields 1A and 1C are on the agenda. Property items include trees of heaven treatment, a memorial bench proposal, and monitoring reports, plus an executive session on real estate.
items: Transition project report from J. Loughlin
Review of the list of tasks in process, with feedback
Follow-up on the memorial bench proposal, led by staff
Property monitoring reports for 205 Main St, Yalesville, by B. Conroy, and Marcus Cooke, by E. Severson
Farmland lease bid status, from staff
Recommendations on tillage specifications for fields 1A and 1C
Trails Work Group reports and coordinator updates
Other reports and correspondence from staff
Executive session on the lease, sale, or purchase of real estate under CGS §1-200(6)(D)
location: Room 3, Parks & Recreation Building, 6 Fairfield Boulevard, Wallingford, CT
